reason: The unfired blanks seem intended to become a durable floor, so heating them is a direct step toward protecting the liner.
expectation: I expect the solar bay to fire the blanks into stronger floor pieces, though they may need further preparation.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric might make a protective layer, but the blanks seem to need firing first.

effect: Firing produced non-pressure ceramic blocks, which seem suitable for paving the growing bay.
reaction: The distinction between paving and pressure-bearing material is useful.
reason: Placing the blocks in the cleared bay should make progress toward a safe floor.
expectation: I expect the blocks to form paving for the liner, possibly needing a protective layer afterward.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric may provide that protective layer, but paving the bay seems like the next step.

effect: The blocks made a level cavern floor; a protective layer may still be needed for the liner.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action, and the felt and fabric may make a protective layer.
expectation: I expect a padded cover for the floor, though its exact use is uncertain.

effect: The felt and fabric made an underlay that protects the pressure skin from ceramic edges.
reaction: The explanation makes the padding's purpose clear.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action, and placing the underlay should finish protecting the floor.
expectation: I expect the underlay to cover the level floor and make it safe for the pressure envelope.

effect: The floor is now protected, and the next goal is to create an inhabited, illuminated room.
reaction: The division between load-bearing blocks and protective underlay makes physical sense.
reason: The pressure envelope is the only offered action and should establish the room on the prepared floor.
expectation: I expect the envelope to be laid out or installed on the protected floor, though it may still need air and lighting.

effect: The envelope is installed with its airlock and service spine; the sealed room still needs breathable air and lighting.
reaction: The separation between imported pressure seals and local structural support is clear.
reason: Adding breathing gas is the only offered gameplay action and should make the sealed room habitable.
expectation: I expect the room to be pressurized with breathable gas; the grow lights may still need to be installed.

effect: The enclosure is pressurized and has passed its leak check; it still needs lighting.
reaction: Stepping into the inflated room is a satisfying payoff to preparing the floor and seals.
reason: Installing the grow-light rails is the only offered gameplay action and addresses the remaining lighting requirement.
expectation: I expect the rails to illuminate the growing room and complete the current goal.

effect: The lights, circulation and heating are running, completing the growing room and the chapter.
reaction: The explanation of the service spine and array capacity makes the finished room feel practically grounded.

mostWorthwhile.text: Pressurizing the enclosure was the strongest payoff: the leak check and walk into the room made the earlier floor and seal work tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Laying the blocks was straightforward but comparatively uneventful, with no detail beyond the resulting level floor.

surprise.text: The explicit distinction between ceramic paving and a pressure-bearing structure clarified how the local materials would be used.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though most of the sequence offered only one gameplay action, so there was little meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the completed room becomes a functioning farm; the practical explanations made its construction interesting.
